description: Shifts a control voltage between the two ranges Rack uses, ±5V and 0-10V, in both directions at once

inputs.text: A ±5V signal to be shifted into 0-10V
A 0-10V signal to be shifted into ±5V

outputs.text: The ±5V input shifted into 0-10V, so -5V becomes 0V and 5V becomes 10V
The 0-10V input shifted into ±5V, so 0V becomes -5V and 10V becomes 5V

notes: nothing is clamped: a voltage outside the stated input range comes out the same distance outside the output range.
